y-m-51-03.title: Yaya yawan mafita ke canzawa idan muka ƙara k?
y-m-51-03.topic: Haɗuwar jadawalin aikin quadratic mai darajar absolute da layi y=k.
y-m-51-03.goal: Hasashen ta hanyar sauya jadawali (naɗe sama) cewa adadin tushen ainihi na |f(x)|=k ya danganta da kewayon k; duba hukuncinka da sabon bayani, sannan zaɓi k-ɗin da suka cika sharadin da kanka.
y-m-51-03.material: f(x)=x²−2x−3=(x+1)(x−3), g(x)=|f(x)|. Muna nemo yawan tushen ainihi dabam-dabam na ma’aunin g(x)=k, wato |f(x)|=k, gwargwadon ƙimar k. (Ana karanta |f(x)| “absolute value na f(x)”.) Ba tare da zana jadawali kai tsaye ba, muna gina hukunci ta bayanan da ke zuwa a hankali.
y-m-51-03.thinking.1: Riƙe ko gyara hukunci bisa sabon bayani.
y-m-51-03.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin sauyin adadi a ƙimomin iyaka.
y-m-51-03.prereq.1: Vertex da wuraren yanke x-axis na aikin quadratic, da adadin tushen ainihi na ma’aunin quadratic.
y-m-51-03.prereq.2: Gaskiyar cewa jadawalin y=|f(x)| yana naɗe sashen f(x)<0 sama da x-axis.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanan mataki-mataki. Kowane lokaci hasashen yawan mafita, idan sabon bayani ya zo kuma duba tunaninka.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana jadawalin y=|f(x)| da kalmomi: a ina aka naɗe shi, ina ne mafi girman wurin sashen da aka naɗe?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.hint.1: Yayin ɗaga layi y=k daga ƙasa, ƙirga tsawon wurare nawa ne adadin maki masu haɗuwa ke canzawa.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.info: y=f(x) parabola ce mai buɗe sama, tana yanke x-axis a x=−1 da x=3, vertex ɗinta kuma (1,−4) ne. Jadawalin y=|f(x)| yana naɗe sashen da f(x) mara kyau ne (−1<x<3) sama da x-axis.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: |f(x)|=1 yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam nawa?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.after: f(x)=1 yana ba da x²−2x−4=0 mai tushen ainihi dabam-dabam biyu; f(x)=−1 yana ba da x²−2x−2=0, shi ma yana da biyu, saboda haka jimilla 4 ne. Jadawalin da aka naɗe yana da sifar W, y=1 ya ratsa shi a wurare huɗu.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wataƙila ka yi tunanin f(x)=1 kawai. Ƙirga wuraren da sashen da aka naɗe ya haɗu da y=1 ma.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ƙirga mafitar f(x)=1 da f(x)=−1 duka.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akwai tsawo na musamman da mafita 3. Duba ko tsawon nan shi ne 1 na yanzu.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wataƙila ka kalli vertex guda ɗaya kawai. Ƙirga duk wuraren da y=1 ya haɗu da jadawali.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sashen da aka naɗe parabola ce mai buɗe ƙasa da vertex (1,4). Ka yi tunanin ɗaga layi y=k daga ƙasa, daga k=1 zuwa k=3.9. [lambobi: 1, 4, 1, 3.9]
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ko da an ɗaga k daga 1 zuwa 3.9, shin yawan mafita zai kasance 4?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.after: A k=3.9 ma, f(x)=3.9 da f(x)=−3.9 kowanne yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam biyu, jimilla 4. Kafin a kai tsawon vertex 4, ya dace a riƙe hasashenka na farko.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yayin matsowa kusa da 3.9, mafita na raguwa ɗaya bayan ɗaya su zama 3.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yawan mafita zai zama 3 ne kawai idan layi ya taɓa daidai tsawon vertex. 3.9 har yanzu bai kai wannan tsawo ba.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Idan aka ƙara ɗagawa, mafita na raguwa su zama 2.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: An ɗauka ɗagawa yana sa mafita su ragu nan take. Sake ƙirga maki nawa ne layi ke haɗuwa da sifar W yayin da tsawo bai kai 4 ba.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yana nan. Har sai ya kai tsawon vertex 4, adadin har yanzu 4 ne.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: An riƙe hasashen farko, an gwada shi da sabon bayani (tsawon vertex 4).
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yayin ƙara ɗagawa, maki masu haɗuwa za su ƙaru su zama 5 ko fiye.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yi tunani mafi yawan maki da lanƙwasa da layi za su iya haɗuwa a tsawo guda a wannan jadawali.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.info: |f(x)|=k (k≥0) daidai yake da f(x)=k ko f(x)=−k. Discriminant na x²−2x−3=k shi ne 16+4k; na x²−2x−3=−k kuma 16−4k ne. Yi amfani da su ka nemo tushen ainihi nawa ne a k=0,4,5. (|f(x)| aƙalla 0 ne, don haka idan k<0 babu mafita.) [lambobi: 0, 2, 3, 16, 4, 2, 3, 16, 4, 0, 4, 5, 0, 0]
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wanne ne taƙaitaccen bayanin da ya fi dacewa kan yawan mafita gwargwadon k?
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Adadin yana canzawa dabam a iyakoki k=0 da k=4; tsakanin da wajen su yana tsayawa a 4 da 2. Hasashen farko (4 ga k=1) ya shafi duk 0<k<4.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka manta cewa a k=4 vertex na sashen da aka naɗe yana taɓa layi a maki guda.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: An manta cewa a k=0 akwai wuraren yanke x-axis biyu (−1, 3).
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan k>4, sake ƙirga maki nawa ne suke haɗuwa sama da sashen da aka naɗe.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: An kuma tsara gaskiyar cewa adadin ya bambanta dabam-dabam a iyakoki k=0 da k=4.
y-m-51-03.s.s1.reflect: Da wane bayani ka riƙe hasashenka na farko na k=1, kuma da wane bayani ka gyara shi bisa tazara?
y-m-51-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri k guda 3 dabam-dabam da |f(x)|=k ke da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam 4. (k lambar ainihi ce.)
y-m-51-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo tazarar da adadin 4 yake ciki daga taƙaitaccen bayani na baya.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.hint.1: Cire ƙimomin iyaka biyu daga zaɓuɓɓuka, ka zaɓi ƙima tsakanin su.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ga wannan k, |f(x)|=k yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam 4.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ga wannan k, tushen ainihi ba 4 ba ne. Kwatanta da tsawo 0 da 4.
y-m-51-03.s.s2.explain: Idan 0<k<4, f(x)=k da f(x)=−k kowanne yana da tushen ainihi dabam-dabam biyu, jimilla 4. Kowace k cikin wannan kewayo amsa ce.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.prompt: Ka bayyana bisa sifar jadawali dalilin da ya sa yawan mafita a k=4 ya bambanta da tazarorin kafin da bayansa, sannan ka rubuta adadin ga 0<k<4 da k>4.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko nemo tsawon mafi girman wurin sashen da aka naɗe, sannan ƙirga wuraren haɗuwa daban ga layi y=k da ya ratsa wannan wurin, ƙasa da shi, ko sama da shi.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bayyana da kalmomi yadda mafi girman wurin sashen da aka naɗe da layi suke haɗuwa.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ya nuna cewa a k=4 layi yana taɓa vertex na sashen da aka naɗe?
y-m-51-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta daidai adadin ga 0<k<4 da k>4?
y-m-51-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana “me ya sa 3 ne” ta sifar, ba lamba kaɗai ba?
y-m-51-03.s.s3.model.0: Tsawon vertex na sashen da aka naɗe shi ne 4, saboda haka a k=4 layi yana taɓa vertex, kuma ƙara wuraren biyun gefe yana ba da 3. Idan 0<k<4, 4 ne; idan k>4, wuraren gefen biyu kawai yake haɗuwa da su, wato 2.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.model.1: y=|f(x)| yana da sifar W, tsawon kololuwar tsakiya 4 ne. Idan layi ya taɓa kololuwar daidai, yana haɗuwa a maki guda a can, jimilla 3; ƙasa da haka 4 ne, sama da haka maki biyu na waje kawai, wato 2.
y-m-51-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta bayyana ta amfani da siffar W.

y-m-51-01.title: Idan ƙimomin aiki a ƙarshen tazara sun bambanta, akwai aiki akasin aiki?
y-m-51-01.topic: Aikin murabba’i mai takaitaccen yankin aiki da samuwar aikin akasin aiki
y-m-51-01.goal: Nuna da misalin karyatawa dalilin da ya sa ƙa’idar “idan ƙimomin aiki a ƙarshen tazara biyu sun bambanta, to haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne” ba ta wadatar ba, sannan ka gina tazarori da dama da aikin akasin aiki yake samuwa a kansu.
y-m-51-01.material: A ce yankin aikin f(x)=x²-4x+3 shi ne tazara a≤x≤b (a<b), kodomen kuma duk ƙimomin da f ke ɗauka a wannan tazara ne (zango). Domin aikin akasin f ya kasance, dole f ya zama haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya a kan tazarar. Sua ta ce, “Idan ƙimomin aiki a ƙarshen tazarar sun bambanta (f(a)≠f(b)), to f haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne a wannan tazara.” (Ana karanta f(x) da “f na x”, x² kuma da “x murabba’i”.)
y-m-51-01.thinking.0: Tantance ko ƙa’idar sharadi ne isasshe ko wajibi.
y-m-51-01.thinking.2: Samar da tazarori da dama bisa ƙuntatawa.
y-m-51-01.prereq.0: “H2” a wannan aikin lakabin wahala ne kawai, ba ya nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan batu a wani aji. A ɗauka ɗalibin ya riga ya yi nazarin abubuwan da ake bukata a ƙasa.
y-m-51-01.prereq.1: Jadawalin aikin murabba’i y=ax²+bx+c da axis ɗinsa (matakin aji na 3 na sakandare)
y-m-51-01.prereq.2: Ayyuka, haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya, da sharadin samuwar aikin akasin aiki (matakin Lissafi na gama gari)
y-m-51-01.s.s1.prompt: Yi amfani da ƙa’idar Sua ga tazara 0≤x≤3. Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa?
y-m-51-01.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafta f(0), f(1), f(2), f(3) a jere a tazara 0≤x≤3, sannan ka rubuta su a tebur.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.hint.1: A cikin teburin, nemo ko akwai ƙimar aiki da ta bayyana sau biyu.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.a: Ƙimomin ƙarshen f(0) da f(3) sun bambanta, saboda haka za mu iya cewa f haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne a wannan tazara.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka kwatanta ƙimomin ƙarshen kaɗai. Ba ka tabbatar ko ƙimomin cikin tazarar ma sun bambanta da juna ba tukuna.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.b: Ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta, amma a cikin tazarar ƙimomi sun yi karo, kamar f(1)=f(3); saboda haka ba za mu ce haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.b: Ba ƙimomin ƙarshen kaɗai ka duba ba, har ma ka duba ko ƙimomin cikin tazarar suna karo.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.c: Ko ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta ba shi da alaƙa da haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya, saboda haka ƙa’idar ba ta da amfani tun farko.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.c: Idan haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ne, ƙimomin ƙarshen dole su bambanta; akwai alaƙa. Matsalar ita ce bambanta kaɗai bai isa ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.o.d: Ko an takaita yankin aiki zuwa tazara, aikin murabba’i ba zai iya zama haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya a kowace tazara ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi tunanin tazarar da ba ta ketare kolo ba ma. A irin wannan tazara ƙimomi ba za su yi karo ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s1.explain: f(0)=3 da f(3)=0, saboda haka ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta; amma f(1)=0=f(3), saboda haka ƙimar aiki ɗaya ta bayyana sau biyu. “Ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta” sharadi ne wajibi kawai ga haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya, ba isasshe ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.prompt: Samar da tazarori 3 daban-daban a≤x≤b (a<b, tsawon tazarar 1 ko fiye) inda aikin akasin aiki yake samuwa. Ƙarshen a da b na tazarar na iya zama lambobin gaske.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi tazara, sannan ka gwada da wasu maki ko f(x) tana ci gaba da motsi alkibla guda yayin da x ke ƙaruwa a cikin tazarar.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙarshen tazarar da matsayin axis na simetri na jadawali, sannan ka gwada tazarori uku ko huɗu da kake tunani.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a<b kuma tsawon tazarar 1 ko fiye ne.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Muna bukatar a<b, kuma tsawon tazarar b-a ya zama 1 ko fiye.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.ok.c2: A wannan tazara, babu ƙimar aiki ɗaya da ke bayyana sau biyu.
y-m-51-01.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan tazara akwai x biyu daban-daban masu ƙimar aiki iri ɗaya. Nemo x1 da x2 a tazarar inda f(x1)=f(x2).
y-m-51-01.s.s2.explain: Tunda f(x)=(x-2)²-1 ne, f(x1)=f(x2) yana nufin x1=x2 ko x1+x2=4. Idan tazarar ta ketare x=2 (a<2<b), akwai maki biyu a ɓangarorin 2 waɗanda jimillarsu 4 ke cikin tazarar, saboda haka ƙimomi za su yi karo. Don haka kowace tazara mai a≥2 ko b≤2 za ta iya zama amsa (misali [2,5], [-1,2], [3,4.5]).
y-m-51-01.s.s3.prompt: Ka amsa wa Sua. Yi amfani da misalin lamba domin bayyana dalilin da ya sa ƙa’idarta kaɗai ba ta wadatar, sannan ka rubuta a jimla ɗaya irin matsayin da tazara dole ta kasance domin aikin akasin aiki ya samu.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.hint.0: Zaɓi tazara da ta cika ƙa’idar Sua amma ƙimomi suka yi karo, sannan ka yi teburin ƙimomin aikinta.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta jimlar a tsarin “misali, ..., saboda haka ...”.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A tazarar da ka bayar, a bayyane yake cewa ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta amma ƙimar aiki ɗaya ta bayyana sau biyu?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi matsayin da tazarar dole ta kasance (dangantakarta da axis)?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bambanta cewa ƙimomin ƙarshen su bambanta sharadi ne wajibi amma ba isasshe ba?
y-m-51-01.s.s3.model.0: A tazara 0≤x≤3, f(0)=3 da f(3)=0, saboda haka ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta, amma f(1)=f(3)=0; ƙima ɗaya ta bayyana sau biyu. Don haka ba haɗin kai ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba ne. Dole tazarar ta kasance a gefe guda kawai na kolo x=2.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.model.1: Duba [1,4]: f(1)=0 da f(4)=3, saboda haka ƙimomin ƙarshen sun bambanta, amma f(1)=f(3), don haka ƙimomi sun yi karo. Jadawalin yana da simetri hagu da dama game da axis x=2; saboda haka tazarar ba za ta ketare axis ba.
y-m-51-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Za ka iya amfani da “kolo” maimakon jimlar “axis x=2”.

y-m-51-07.title: Shin haɗuwar jadawali da aikin inverse kullum tana kan y=x?
y-m-51-07.topic: Haɗuwar jadawalin aiki da jadawalin inverse ɗinsa.
y-m-51-07.goal: Kada hujjar aiki guda ta tabbatar maka da da’awar “haɗuwar f da f⁻¹ kullum tana kan y=x”; ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa da aiki mai raguwa, ka bayyana wa aboki yadda ya bambanta da aiki mai ƙaruwa.
y-m-51-07.material: Minjae ya ce, “Maki inda y=f(x) da inverse ɗinsa y=f⁻¹(x) suka haɗu kullum suna kan layi y=x, domin jadawalinsu suna daidaita da juna game da y=x.” A matsayin hujja ya warware f(x)=x³ (yankin aiki duk lambobin ainihi), ya nuna haɗuwarsu (−1,−1), (0,0), (1,1) duk suna kan y=x. (Ana karanta f⁻¹ “f inverse”.)
y-m-51-07.thinking.0: Yanke iyakar abin da hujjar ke nunawa.
y-m-51-07.thinking.2: Faɗi sharadin da ya sa furucin ke aiki (aiki mai ƙaruwa).
y-m-51-07.prereq.1: Ma’anar aikin inverse da dangantakar jadawalin f da f⁻¹.
y-m-51-07.prereq.2: Siffofin jadawalin aikin ƙarfi x³ da −x³.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi tantancewar da ta fi dacewa game da hujjar Minjae.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ko f(x)=x³ yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa, sannan tuna wani misalin siffa dabam (aiki mai raguwa).
y-m-51-07.s.s1.hint.1: Domin haɗuwa (a,b) ta kasance kan f da f⁻¹ duka, duka (a,b) da (b,a) dole su kasance a kan f. Rubuta ma’anar a matsayin furuci.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.a: Aiki guda ɗaya kawai ya gwada; ya kamata ya gwada aiki marar ƙaruwa ma.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka lura cewa kafin faɗaɗa sakamakon aiki guda ga duk ayyuka, dole ne a gwada wasu nau’o’i.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.b: Haɗuwa uku sun bayyana, don haka ana iya cewa an gwada isassun yanayi.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.b: Samun maki da dama ga aiki ɗaya gwajin aiki ɗaya ne. Ko haka yake ga wasu ayyuka wani abu dabam ne.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.c: Jadawali masu daidaito game da y=x dole su haɗu a kan y=x, saboda haka hujjar ta ƙare.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.c: Duba ko akwai yanayin da jadawali biyu masu daidaito suke haɗuwa wajen y=x. Ko da suna daidaito, maki biyu masu fuskantar juna na iya zama haɗuwa duka.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.d: Aikin cubic ba shi da inverse, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da wannan hujja tun farko ba.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.d: f(x)=x³ haɗin kai-da-kai ne a duk lambobin ainihi, saboda haka yana da inverse. Ko za a iya amfani da hujja da ko ta isa abubuwa ne dabam.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x³ aiki ne mai ƙaruwa. Ga ayyuka masu ƙaruwa haɗuwa tana kan y=x, amma ga masu raguwa ba lallai ba ne. Gwajin aiki guda ba ya tabbatar da da’awar gaba ɗaya.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.prompt: Ga f(x)=−x³ (yankin aiki duk lambobin ainihi ne, haɗin kai-da-kai), nemo maki (a,b) da ke kan jadawalin f da f⁻¹ amma ba sa kan y=x. Ƙirƙiri maki biyu dabam-dabam. [lambobi: 2]
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta dabam furucin da ke tabbatar da (a,b) yana kan f, da wanda ke tabbatar yana kan f⁻¹ (furuci mai musanya a da b).
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.1: Saka ƙananan lambobi kamar −1, 0, 1 cikin a don nemo b, ka duba ko furuci na biyu ma ya cika.

y-m-51-02.prereq.0: “H2” a wannan aikin lakabin wahala ne kawai, ba ya nufin manhaja ta sanya wannan batu a wani aji. A ɗauka ɗalibin ya riga ya yi nazarin abubuwan da ake bukata a ƙasa.
y-m-51-02.title: Idan aka sauya jerin haɗa ayyuka, sakamakon iri ɗaya ne?
y-m-51-02.goal: Ka sani cewa wasu ƙimomin x kaɗan da suka ba da sakamako iri ɗaya bayan an sauya jeri ba sa tabbatar da ayyukan biyu iri ɗaya ne. Kai da kanka ka gina nau’i-nau’in ayyuka masu layi inda jeri ba ya tasiri, sannan ka bayyana ƙa’idar.
y-m-51-02.material: Ayyuka biyu ne f(x)=2x+1 da g(x)=x². Minsu ya ce, “Ayyukan haɗaka iri ɗaya ne ko da an musanya jeri. Na gwada da kaina. Idan x=0, f(g(0))=1, g(f(0))=1. Idan x=-2, f(g(-2))=9, g(f(-2))=9. Dukansu iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka f∘g=g∘f.” (Ana karanta f∘g da “f haɗe da g”, g(x) kuma da “g na x”.)
y-m-51-02.thinking.0: Sake duba ikirarin da aka gamaɗa daga wasu daidaito kaɗan.
y-m-51-02.thinking.1: Samar da misalai da dama bisa ƙuntatawa.
y-m-51-02.prereq.2: Sigar aikin mai layi ax+b da ma’anar furuci biyu su yi daidai ga duk x
y-m-51-02.s.s1.prompt: Wane tantancewa ne ya fi dacewa ga hujjar Minsu?
y-m-51-02.s.s1.hint.0: Saka x=1, sannan ka lissafta f(g(1)) da g(f(1)) dabam.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta furuci biyun kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta ga x nawa suke daidaitawa.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.a: Sun yi daidai a ƙimomin biyu, saboda haka ya isa a kammala cewa f∘g=g∘f.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.a: Daidaito a ƙimomi biyu ba ya tabbatar da cewa za su yi daidai ga duk x. Za ka iya gwada wasu x kuma.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.b: Musanya jerin haɗakar ayyuka yana ba da aiki daban koyaushe; saboda haka ba zai yiwu tun farko sakamakon Minsu ya zama daidai ba.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.b: Akwai nau’i-nau’in ayyuka da suke nan yadda suke idan an musanya jeri. Kasancewar wannan nau’in bai yi daidai ba ba ya nufin duk nau’i-nau’i haka suke.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.c: Ko da sun yi daidai idan x=0 da -2, dole su yi daidai ga duk x; saboda haka ya kamata mu lissafta wasu ƙimomi kamar x=1.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana duba “duk x”, ba yawan ƙimomin da suka yi daidai ba. Ka san cewa wani x guda na iya karya ikirarin cewa ayyukan biyu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.d: An gwada x-ɗin 0 da lamba mara kyau kawai, saboda haka matsalar ita ce alamomin sun bambanta; idan aka gwada da lamba mai kyau zai zama iri ɗaya.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.d: Ba matsalar alamomi ba ce. Furucin da kansa ke yanke wane x ne zai sa su yi daidai. Yi lissafi kai tsaye da x=1 mai kyau.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.explain: f(g(x))=2x²+1, g(f(x))=(2x+1)²=4x²+4x+1, kuma furucin biyun suna daidaita ne kawai idan x=0, −2. A x=1 sun zama 3 da 9, saboda haka sun bambanta. Ko da sun dace a wasu x kaɗan, don zama “aiki ɗaya” dole su yi daidai ga duk x.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.prompt: A ce f(x)=ax+b (a≠0), g(x)=x+c. Ƙirƙiri (a,b,c) guda 3 dabam-dabam ta yadda f∘g=g∘f ga duk x, amma f da g ayyuka dabam-dabam ne.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta kowanne f(g(x)) da g(f(x)) a sifar ax+(adadi), ka kwatanta sassan adadi.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka ƙananan cikakkun lambobi cikin a da c, ka yi tebur don duba ko sassan adadin sun daidaita.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.var.a: Adadin coefficient a na x a f.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.var.b: Adadin marar canji b na f.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.var.c: Adadin marar canji c na g.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Furucin f(g(x)) da g(f(x)) iri ɗaya ne ga duk x.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan aka shirya f(g(x)) da g(f(x)) kowanne a sifar ax+(…), sassan adadin sun bambanta.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f da g ayyuka dabam-dabam ne.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.fail.c3: f da g sun zama aiki ɗaya.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.explain: f(g(x))=a(x+c)+b=ax+ac+b, g(f(x))=ax+b+c. Domin furucin biyun su yi daidai ga duk x, muna buƙatar ac+b=b+c, wato ac=c. Don haka c=0 ko a=1 yana aiki (misali a=3,b=2,c=0 ko a=1,b=2,c=5). Rassan biyun amsoshi ne.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.prompt: Daga misalan da ka ƙirƙira yanzu, rubuta ƙa’idar (a,b,c) da ke sa f∘g=g∘f. Ka kuma ƙara lokacin da maganar Minsu take daidai kawai.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta furuci biyun da aka samu daga shirya f(g(x)) da g(f(x)).
y-m-51-02.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta ƙimomin a da c na misalan ukun gefe da gefe ka nemo abin da suka yi tarayya.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ƙa’idar ta dace da misalan ukun da ka ƙirƙira?
y-m-51-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka samu rassan biyun (yanayin a=1 da yanayin c=0)? Idan ɗaya kaɗai ka samu, ka yi tunanin ko ɗayan na iya kasancewa.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka ce “daidai ne a wasu lokuta kawai” tare da dalili?
y-m-51-02.s.s3.model.0: f∘g=ax+ac+b kuma g∘f=ax+b+c, saboda haka suna daidai ne idan ac=c. Don haka ana buƙatar a=1 ko c=0. Maganar Minsu daidai ce a waɗannan yanayi kaɗai.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.model.1: Tunda g=x+c ne, idan c=0 to g(x)=x, saboda haka jere ba ya da muhimmanci ga kowace f; idan gangarar f ta zama 1, duka sauye-sauyen adadi ne, saboda haka jere ba ya da muhimmanci. Maganar Minsu daidai ce a waɗannan lokuta kawai.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan amsa ce da ta bayyana dalilin lissafi ba tare da faɗaɗa furucin ba.

y-m-51-04.title: Wane tarin bayanai ne ke kayyade aikin rational guda?
y-m-51-04.topic: Bayanin da ake buƙata don kayyade jadawalin aikin rational.
y-m-51-04.goal: Warware bayanin da ke kayyade aikin rational y=k/(x−p)+q zuwa guda da wanda ba ya kayyade, sannan lura da sharuddan da ba za su yiwu ba kamar maki a kan asimptot.
y-m-51-04.material: Muna son kayyade jadawalin aikin rational y=k/(x−p)+q (k≠0). Asimptot ɗinsa layuka x=p da y=q ne. Cikin tarin sharudda biyar na gaba, zaɓi duk waɗanda bayanin kaɗai zai kayyade jadawali guda. (Ana karanta k/(x−p) “k bisa x a cire p”.)

y-m-51-05.title: Bincika aikin da ya nemo mafi ƙaranci a tazara.
y-m-51-05.topic: Mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci na aikin quadratic mai takaitaccen yankin aiki.
y-m-51-05.goal: Nemo kuskure a aikin neman mafi ƙaranci na quadratic a tazara da ya manta yanayin da vertex yake wajen tazara, sannan gina tazara da dama inda mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci suke da ƙimomin da aka bayar.
y-m-51-05.material: Wannan matsala ce ta nemo mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci na f(x)=x²−4x+1 idan yankin aiki 3≤x≤6 ne. Aikin Junho kamar haka. (Ana karanta x² “x murabba’i”, ≤ kuma “ya gaza ko daidai”.)
y-m-51-05.thinking.1: Sake duba yayin tabbatar da sharudda.

y-m-51-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a aikin Junho wanda hujjarsa ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-51-05.s.s1.hint.0: Duba ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ƙimar x da aka yi amfani da ita a kowane layi tana cikin yankin aiki 3≤x≤6.

y-m-51-05.s.s1.line.1: Vertex na jadawali shi ne (2,−3), saboda haka mafi ƙaranci −3 ne.
y-m-51-05.s.s1.line.2: f(3)=−2 kuma f(6)=13, saboda haka mafi girma 13 ne.
y-m-51-05.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka mafi ƙaranci −3 ne, mafi girma kuma 13.
y-m-51-05.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne kuskuren tushe. x-coordinate na vertex, 2, ba ya cikin yankin 3≤x≤6, saboda haka −3 ba ya faruwa a wannan tazara. Layi na 4 ƙarshe ne da ya gaji wannan kuskure. Lissafin layi na 1 da na 3 daidai ne. A wannan tazara jadawali yana hawa zuwa dama, don haka mafi ƙaranci f(3)=−2 ne a x=3.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.prompt: Ga wannan aikin f(x)=x²−4x+1 a tazara a≤x≤b (a<b), ƙirƙiri tazara guda 3 dabam-dabam da mafi ƙaranci −3 ne, mafi girma kuma 6.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yanke inda tazara dole ta ratsa domin x da ke ba da mafi ƙaranci −3 ya kasance cikin tazarar.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo x da f(x)=6, ka yi tunani ko ƙarshen tazara dole ya zama wannan ƙima.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Mafi ƙaranci −3 yana faruwa a cikin tazara.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan tazara mafi ƙaranci ba −3 ba ne. Duba ko x mai ba da mafi ƙaranci yana cikin tazara.

y-m-51-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Mafi girma cikin tazara ba 6 ba ne. Kwatanta ƙimomin aikin a ƙarshen tazara biyun.

y-m-51-05.s.s3.prompt: Ka gaya wa Junho inda kuskure ya faru, ka rubuta mafi ƙaranci madaidaiciya a wannan tazara da dalili.
y-m-51-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta a jimla ko x=2 da Junho ya yi amfani da shi yana cikin yankin aiki 3≤x≤6.

y-m-51-08.title: Me kuma ake buƙata domin kayyade layin tangent guda?
y-m-51-08.topic: Sharadin tangent tsakanin aikin quadratic da layi.
y-m-51-08.goal: Fahimci cewa ga layi y=mx+n mai tangent da parabola, sharadin tangent yana ba da dangantaka guda ɗaya tsakanin gangara da y-intercept; yanke hukunci ko ƙarin bayani yana kayyade layi guda (guda, biyu ko babu).
y-m-51-08.material: Muna son nemo layi y=mx+n mai tangent da parabola y=x²−2x+3. (Tangent yana nufin ya haɗu da parabola a maki guda.) Sharadin tangent kaɗai ba ya kayyade layi guda. Bayan sharadin tangent, wanne daga cikin bayanan ƙasa ke kayyade layi guda tak? (Ana karanta x²−2x+3 “x murabba’i a cire 2x a ƙara 3”.)

y-m-51-10.material: Wannan bayanin jadawalin aikin quadratic y=ax²+bx+c ne da kalmomi. Jadawalin yana buɗe ƙasa (convex sama), vertex ɗinsa yana sama-dama da y-axis (kwata ta farko), yana yanke y-axis a ɓangaren tabbatacce (sama da asali), kuma yana yanke x-axis a maki biyu dabam-dabam.
